title: "We're not asking for charity": Wikimedia CEO calls out AI for unpaid data use
key_facts: New Wikimedia Foundation chief executive Bernadette Meehan told Axios that Wikipedia page views fell 8% in 2025.
She said the drop was not unexpected but is a concern; Axios links it to AI tools giving people Wikipedia-based information without visiting the site.
Some companies that rely heavily on Wikipedia's content will not pay for it, she said.

Wikimedia charges large-scale commercial users for reliable, high-volume access; publicly disclosed enterprise customers include Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta and Perplexity, and their payments make up 10% of operating expenses.
OpenAI and Anthropic are not among the publicly disclosed enterprise customers; Meehan said Wikimedia has other agreements that are not public and declined to name the companies.
About 80% of Wikimedia's operating budget comes from small donations, many prompted by banners shown to visitors; fewer readers also means fewer people becoming editors.
Meehan said AI should help Wikipedia's human editors rather than replace them: "I don't think you will ever see AI writing or generating Wikipedia articles."
quote_evidence: Wikipedia page views declined 8% in 2025, and while the drop wasn't unexpected, "that doesn't mean that we're sort of starry-eyed about it and not concerned about it," Meehan said.
OpenAI and Anthropic, two of the largest makers of generative AI models, aren't among Wikimedia's publicly disclosed enterprise customers.
Wikipedia makes its content freely available and has no intention of changing that, leaving it with limited leverage over AI companies that don't want to pay.
why_it_matters_hint: Wikipedia's head says AI is cutting its traffic and not always paying for the content it relies on.
event_date: Not stated; Google News lists the article on 2 Oct 2026
notes: The article is Axios content carried on Yahoo Finance. The interview date is not stated. The 8% fall is Wikimedia's own figure for 2025 and the article does not show that AI is the only cause.
